_comment: Websites built with Astro Stardrive. Add yours via a pull request: append an object with 'title', 'description' and 'url'. Language must be English. Add translations for German, Spanish, and French (aka the demo languages) optionally. Entries are sorted alphabetically by title automatically, so order here does not matter. Requirement: your site must still expose the <meta name="generator" content="Astro Stardrive" /> tag (present by default) so it can be verified. No links to content unsuitable for children (e.g. gambling, sexual/pornographic, or alcohol-related).
